segments.text: 各位观众,今天给大家带来的是 ACM UbiComp / IMWUT 2021 的论文《Attend and Discriminate: Beyond the State-of-the-Art for Human Activity Recognition Using Wearable Sensors》。
这篇论文由 Alireza Abedin、Mahsa Ehsanpour 等作者完成,目前已经被引用 102 次,研究方向涉及Context-Aware Activity Recognition Systems、Gait Recognition and Analysis、Human Pose and Action Recognition。

用论文自己的话来说:Wearables are fundamental to improving our understanding of human activities, especially for an increasing number of healthcare applications from rehabilitation to fine-grained gait analysis.
如果你想快速抓住重点,可以记住这几个关键词:Context-Aware Activity Recognition Systems、Gait Recognition and Analysis、Human Pose and Action Recognition。
